workspace.localHint: The collection is saved in the app's data on this computer
workspace.browserHint: The collection is saved in this browser. Keeping it as files in a folder needs the desktop app.
workspace.restrictedHint: Scripts, OAuth 2.0 settings, local MCP commands and file reads in this folder are off until you trust it
workspace.trusted: This folder is trusted now. Its scripts, OAuth 2.0 settings, local MCP commands and file reads are on.
workspace.restrictedOpened: This folder is not trusted yet. Its scripts, OAuth 2.0 settings, local MCP commands and file reads stay off until you choose Trust this folder in the folder menu.
workspace.switcherDescription: Choose another folder, pinned or recent
workspace.switchDescription: Switch to this workspace and keep the tabs of the current one
workspace.noWorkspaces: Folders you open are listed here, so you can switch between them.
workspace.renameMessage: Name shown in the list. The folder on disk keeps its name. Leave empty to use the folder name.
workspace.forgetMessage: Remove {{name}} from the list? The folder and its files stay on disk, and its trust and saved tokens are forgotten.
workspace.listFailed: Could not read the list of folders
workspace.saveFailed: Could not save the collection to the folder
workspace.revealFailed: Could not open the folder in the file explorer
workspace.diskReloaded: Files changed on disk were reloaded.
workspace.diskReloadedWithProblems_one: Files changed on disk were reloaded. {{count}} file could not be read; choose Reload from disk to see which.
workspace.diskReloadedWithProblems_other: Files changed on disk were reloaded. {{count}} files could not be read; choose Reload from disk to see which.
workspace.diskChanged: This request changed on disk while you were editing it.
workspace.vanished: This request is no longer in the collection, for example after a Git pull, a branch switch or a restore. Save to add it back, or close the tab.
workspace.pickFolderTitle: Choose a folder for the collection

storageActions.cloneMessage: Address of the repository to clone. Sign-in uses your git credential helper or SSH agent. Next, choose the folder to clone into.
storageActions.trustMessage: Requests in this folder can carry scripts, OAuth 2.0 settings, commands that start local MCP servers and {{example}} placeholders that send files from this computer. They run when a request is sent and can read your variables. Its gostman.yaml can also send your requests through a proxy and add a CA certificate it names, and its variables can read your secret managers. Trust the folder only if you know where its files came from.
storageActions.skippedNote: These files were skipped and left unchanged. Fix them, then choose Reload from disk.
